state_words.wired: the data exists on main today

data.name: Data
data.means: a value saved in a data file, shown as it is

rule.name: Rule
rule.means: the page works it out from data by its own rule; the rule lives in the page, so two pages can disagree

media.name: Pictures and video
media.means: a picture, clip or voice file kept on Drive

layout.name: Layout
layout.means: how the page is arranged, ordered or navigated, or a line of help; no data of its own

action.name: Action
action.means: a button that changes something; it runs a component's own command

features.name: Pick a run
features.place: The mini's list of runs
features.note: Version A uses a dropdown. Version B uses tabs that show each run's state at a glance.

features.name: When the data was saved
features.place: The mini's list of runs, its saved time
features.note: Both pages say 'saved snapshot, not live'. The list is rebuilt at most every 5 minutes, and only when something changed.

features.name: Back to the run list
features.place: No data. A link back to the list.
features.note: Off the dashboard there is no shared run list page. A personal page needs its own list, built from feature 1's data.

features.name: What the work is
features.place: The run's detail file: brand, step, work name, route

features.name: Who filed it, who owns the work
features.place: Who filed: the run's detail file. Who owns: the mini's run record.
features.note: The owner is only in the mini's run record, not in the detail file. A page needs both files, or the detail file gains an owner field.

features.name: The run's state
features.place: The run's detail file, its saved state
features.note: Saved words: done, failed, refused, held, running. Both pages turn 'failed' into plainer states (Stopped, Can't run here) by their own reading.

features.name: What kind of stop
features.place: Worked out by the page from the run's last lines

source.field: result.reason, result.tail (read by the page's rules)

features.note: Not saved anywhere. Each page has its own rules, so two pages can disagree.

features.name: The headline in plain words
features.place: Worked out by the page from the run's last lines

features.name: Who moves it on, and what to do
features.place: Worked out by the page
features.note: Version A sends machine faults to the developer and creative ones to the work's owner. Version B marks every run 'Needs you' in red.

features.name: How sure the page is, and when to rethink
features.place: Worked out by the page

features.name: How long it took, and how long it waited
features.place: The run's detail file, its times
features.note: Both pages were drawn before the detail file had a pickup time. A uses the start time as pickup; B says pickup is not supplied. The file has it now.

features.name: Cost in dollars
features.place: Nowhere yet
features.note: No dollar figure is saved anywhere. The pages show one typed from a chat thread. Needs token use (feature 27) times the model rates in components/models/models.json, where many models are still unpriced. A run on someone's Claude plan is not billed per dollar.

features.name: Whose Claude plan paid
features.place: The run's detail file, the plan it used
features.note: Empty for 129 of 153 runs, the older ones. Set on runs since per-person tokens.

features.name: How many files it saved
features.place: The mini's run record (full count); the detail file lists up to 50
features.note: The detail file lists at most 50 paths. The full count is in the mini's run record.

features.name: Section list and order
features.place: No data. The page's own layout.
features.note: Version A: steps, inputs, saved, why it stopped, cost, ask. Version B puts why it stopped second, then inputs, steps, saved, cost, ask.

features.name: Step by step
features.place: The run's detail file has the field, but it is empty
features.note: Empty for all 153 runs: the steps print no step lines. Both pages rebuild steps from saved output lines instead. Needs each step to print a step line.

features.name: What comes after this run
features.place: Nowhere yet
features.note: Both pages guess the next station. No run is linked to the next run of the same work. Needs a link from one run to the next.

features.name: Which copies it used, and how old
features.place: The run's detail file, its input lines
features.note: 12 of 153 runs have them: the runs since the station-path runner (LD-53) started writing them.

features.name: Files to read first
features.place: The run's detail file, its saved files
features.note: The page picks which files matter by their names.

features.name: Where the outputs went on Drive
features.place: A Drive record each run will write (carded today)
features.note: Today only an output line says 'handed on … to Shared Assets/…', and that folder's name can differ from the run's name. The Drive-id cards fix both.

features.name: The mini's folder and the repo copy
features.place: The run's detail file and the mini's run record

features.name: Other tries at the same work
features.place: The run's detail file, its work name, matched across runs
features.note: The run list does not carry the work name, so a page must open every detail file to find the other tries.

features.name: Why it stopped, in the run's own words
features.place: The run's detail file, its reason and last lines

features.name: The stop, item by item
features.place: The audit file the run wrote, or the run's last lines
features.note: Failed audit checks come from the audit file, copied into git as text. Unapproved clips come from the last lines, which keep at most 20.

features.name: Things the page noticed
features.place: Worked out by the page from the run's last lines
features.note: Contradictions, and files that won't open on another machine. Shows only on runs that have them.

features.name: The run's last lines
features.place: The run's detail file, its last lines
features.note: At most 20 lines. The mini already drops Python warnings.

features.name: Claude use by model
features.place: The run's detail file, its Claude calls and token use
features.note: Token use is measured only on runs that used a person's token. Login runs count calls only.

features.name: Ask your own Claude
features.place: The run list names each run's detail file
features.note: Both pages call the file 'proposed'. It is published now, one per run.

features.name: The chat thread about this run
features.place: The run's detail file has the field, but it is empty
features.note: No run has one: chat thread folders are named after people and sessions, not runs.

features.name: Record details
features.place: The run's detail file and the mini's run record
features.note: Code version and exit code are only in the mini's run record.

features.name: Tap a number for what it means
features.place: No data. The page explains its own numbers.
features.note: Both pages explain every number when you tap it.

features.name: Pictures the run made
features.place: Drive, found through the run's Drive record (carded today)
features.note: Shown as small Drive previews, fetched with the viewer's own Drive key by their own page server.

features.name: Play the clips and the voice
features.place: Drive, found through the run's Drive record (carded today)
features.note: Full files stream once and are kept on the viewer's machine.

features.name: The swipe beside the result
features.place: The run's input lines name the swipe video's Drive path
features.note: The swipe video is named by Drive path only. It needs a Drive id, like the outputs.

features.name: Live progress while it runs
features.place: Nowhere yet
features.note: Needs step lines (feature 16) and a faster refresh than the run list's 5 minutes.

features.name: Is the mini working right now
features.place: The run list has the field, but off the dashboard it says nothing
features.note: Each slot says 'needs the dashboard': the heartbeat is served only by the dashboard. A personal page needs it in the file.

features.name: Run it again
features.place: A new mini run, filed the way the mini-run skill files one
features.note: No button on either page: pages only read. A button would file the request through the mini-run skill's own command, never write records itself.
